description: **Check the linked project at the start of every new conversation in a directory.** Call this FIRST (alongside memory_query) before answering questions about the user's project, code, or work — it tells you which ContextForge project and spaces are scoped to the current working directory. If `linked: false`, surface that to the user and suggest `memory_link_project`. Pair this with memory_query as your two startup-context calls — they are the cheapest possible way to avoid hallucinating about the user's project.
name: memory_current_project
